name: webxterm
description: Zero-install web SSH client: browser, key, connect. Nothing to install on either end.

scripts.sshd: docker build -q -t webxterm-sshd deploy/sshd && (docker rm -f webxterm-sshd >/dev/null 2>&1 || true) && docker run -d --name webxterm-sshd -p 2222:22 webxterm-sshd
scripts.relay: RELAY_SECRET=${RELAY_SECRET:-dev-relay-secret-change-me} RELAY_ALLOW_PRIVATE=1 RELAY_PORTS=22,2222 RELAY_ADDR=127.0.0.1:8080 cargo run --release -p webxterm-relay
